function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, pl.sku, p.product_name,
       pl.period,
       pl.qty,
       pl.unit_price_orig,
       pl.contract_unit_price,
       pl.fx_rate,
       (pl.unit_price_orig - pl.contract_unit_price) * pl.qty * pl.fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
  AND pl.unit_price_orig > pl.contract_unit_price
ORDER BY pl.vendor_id, pl.sku, pl.period","purpose":"List purchase lines where unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price for Aug and Sep 2026, with excess CAD"}
